lang.label: Language of this page
app.tagline: Press the button. Your own ComfyUI writes, casts, performs and films a radio play.
notice.asking: Asking your ComfyUI what it can make... (slower while it is rendering)
notice.unreachable: Cannot reach your ComfyUI: {error}  Start ComfyUI, then reload. (python -m radio_play_studio doctor says what is missing.)
field.bank.label: Story bank
field.bank.help: Where the story comes from. Pick shakespeare or public_domain to adapt a classic, my_story to use your own details below, or roll to be surprised.
field.source_ref.label: Source to adapt
field.source_ref.help: Optional. Name the classic to adapt (needs a named bank, not the roll).
field.language.label: Language
field.acts.label: Acts
field.cast_size.label: Cast size
field.style.label: Visual style
field.style.help: Restyles the still and video prompts, so it shows once a video lane draws from stills. On the audio-reactive lanes it changes the file name, not the picture.
field.stills.label: Still pictures
field.stills.help: The open model that paints every still the video starts from -- the characters, the announcer and the music. moss_image (MOSS-Image, Apache-2.0, about 13 GB the first time) is the 16 GB pick; flux3_klein is a little faster. Tell my own story paints its characters from their pictures with flux3_klein (flux3_klein_ref); pick another model to switch that off.
field.my_characters.label: Who is in it
field.my_characters.help: Names, how they know each other, what they are like. Put (she) or (he) right after a name and that character is voiced and drawn that way; anyone unmarked is cast to fit the part. Leave it empty and the cast is invented for you.
field.my_photos.label: Character photos
field.my_photos.help: Optional. One line per character, Name = file, naming a picture in ComfyUI's input folder. The character's portrait is painted from it, in the episode's style, and every still follows the portrait. The cast cards fill this in when you add a photo.
field.my_plot.label: What happens
field.my_plot.help: Events, the trouble, a twist, the ending you want. Rough notes are fine: what you ask for outranks anything the writer would rather invent, and what you leave out is invented to fit.
field.my_setting.label: Where and when
field.my_setting.help: Place, era, weather, mood. This is the story's world, not its look: the Visual style choice sets the look.
field.my_author.label: Written by
field.my_author.help: Your name, a pen name, or whoever you want it credited to. The announcer says it and the closing credits print it; leave it empty and the episode credits one of our listeners.
mode.classic.title: A classic, or surprise me
mode.classic.text: Adapt Shakespeare or a public-domain story, or roll the dice.
mode.own.title: Tell my own story
mode.own.text: Write who is in it, what happens and where. The rest is filled in for you.
cast.label: Who is in it
cast.help: One card per character. Say how they look in fixed terms (age, build, face, hair, clothes) so they look the same in every shot, and add up to three photos of them if you like: their portrait is painted from it, in the episode's style, and every still follows that portrait. Photos need the flux3_klein still pictures. Leave the cards empty and the cast is invented for you.
card.name: Name
card.who_ph: Who they are: their part in the story, what they are like.
card.look_ph: How they look, in fixed terms: age, build, face, hair, the clothes they always wear.
photo.limit: Up to {n} photos of the same face
photo.too_old: This ComfyUI's Old-Time Radio pack is too old for photos; update it.
photo.sending: Sending the photo to your ComfyUI...
status.queued: Queued on your ComfyUI. A full episode takes a while; the bar moves in steps.
error.lost: Lost the connection to the app. Reload to pick the episode back up; if the app was restarted it is no longer tracked here, but it may still be rendering on your ComfyUI, and its episode lands in otr/obs.
error.untracked: That episode is not tracked any more (the app was restarted). If it was still rendering, it lands in your ComfyUI output folder under otr/obs.
